title: TIC-80
summary: TIC-80 fantasy computer: make, play and share tiny retro games
description:
TIC-80 is a fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games, by Vadim Grigoruk (nesbox). This is an unofficial build for the CardputerZero, not affiliated with nesbox.

- Runs on the internal panel: the 240x136 TIC-80 screen at scale 1 inside its border.
- Gamepad on the keyboard: F/X/Z/C move, L/K are A/B, O/I are X/Y. Change it in the game menu under Options.
- Console and code editor work from the keyboard. Write games in Lua, JavaScript, Python, Fennel, MoonScript, Wren, Janet, Squirrel, Scheme, Forth or WASM.
- Type demo in the console to install the demo carts, then load quest.tic and run.

The sprite, map and music editors expect a mouse. Type exit in the console to go back to the launcher.

TIC-80: https://tic80.com
Source: https://github.com/nesbox/TIC-80
Docs: https://github.com/nesbox/TIC-80/wiki
This build: https://github.com/andreahaku/tic80-c0
